mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, when accompanied by a simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST), signals a durable demand expansion that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 qoq acceleration > 0.5% AND HOUST rises > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure margins and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -0.5% quarter-over-quarter, when accompanied by a simultaneous fall in housing starts (HOUST) below -1%, signals a durable demand contraction that reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 qoq acceleration < -0.5% AND HOUST falls > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below -0.3 percentage points signals an improvement in labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals a recovery in manufacturing activity, which improves earnings visibility and reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).
